# Fonts of the user interface, generated by tools/make_font.py --all.
# Sources: Galmuri by Lee Minseo, SIL Open Font License (src/OFL.md), reduced
# to the characters the kernel shows (RANGES in tools/make_font.py).
# output-name   source               [fallback for missing characters] [+cjk]
# +cjk adds the kanji (CJK_RANGES). The title font has none of its own: the
# kernel takes them from font_body (src/platform/gba/assets_gba.c).
font_body       Galmuri11.bdf        +cjk
font_small      Galmuri9.bdf         +cjk
font_title      Galmuri11-Bold.bdf   Galmuri11.bdf
